# LamaniSync (https://lamanisync.com)
> High-Reliability Clinic Management System (CMS) & EMR Data Synchronization Engine for LamaniHub.

## Executive Summary
LamaniSync is the dedicated healthcare synchronization bridge connecting clinic management software (Kreloses, Dentrix Ascend, eClinicalWorks, Plato, and regional EMRs) to LamaniHub 24/7 WhatsApp AI patient booking and triage workflows. It runs as an ephemeral, ambient workstation bridge (Manifest V3) on authenticated front-desk terminals, executing deterministic two-way readback verification without database tampering, port forwarding, or legacy vendor licensing fees.

## Core Architectural Pillars
- **Sovereign Workstation Bridge**: Runs client-side within staff-authenticated clinic browser sessions. Eliminates the need for vendor tollways, proprietary API keys, or on-premise background daemons.
- **Two-Way Readback Verification**: Every appointment injected or slot read is cryptographically verified against the CMS DOM state before confirming booking receipts to patients. Zero phantom bookings.
- **Zero-Port Security**: 100% outbound WebCrypto connections (AES-256-GCM / Ed25519). Zero open inbound ports, zero local background listeners.
- **Zero-Disk Ephemeral Guarantee**: Operates strictly in volatile memory. No Protected Health Information (PHI) is persisted to local disk or unencrypted browser caches. Fully compliant with Malaysian PDPA 2010 and HIPAA data privacy mandates.
- **Hardware-Level Idempotency & Mutex Locks**: Prevents race conditions during simultaneous front-desk walk-in and online WhatsApp appointment booking across multi-workstation clinic clusters.
